'''Bobe Ojgrib''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Ojgrib worked as an assistant to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren]], on the floating [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Chola Mavra]], on [[Genarius]]. When the [[heroes of Cularin]] traveled to Chola Mavra in about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Ojgrib escorted them to where Senator Wren was waiting to meet them. Afterward, Ojgrib escorted the heroes back to their [[Starship/Legends|ship]].
